items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I knew George Wettling before I knew of a Davy Tough or what have you

ctx.x: Davy Tough had fluctuated around, he had jammed around, he had hung out with everybody. But ah, I want to interject something. There's a drummer we don't mention that was better than Gene and better than Davy. George Wettling. I knew George Wettling before I knew of a Davy Tough or what have you, but he also even playing with Paul Whiteman, he was hamstrung. He didn't get a chance to play where he wanted to play because of our social conditions.
It was my pleasure to work with him and I enjoyed every moment of it. Truly a great drummer.
